title: Life Simulator — autonomous game gauntlet
subtitle: Builder/critic loop toward a world that plays itself. Bars are set by gauntlets/00-master-autonomous-game.md and are not negotiable by builders.

bars.claim: All three species persist 60,000 frames on critic-chosen seeds.
bars.status: Survives on paper, dies in practice. Seeds 41/42/43 all reach frame 60,000, but both animal tiers finish sitting on the immigration rescue floor (8/5, 6/12, 12/11). The herbivore curve terminal-crashes on every seed.
bars.metric: score 22.4 / 24.8 / 22.7 — against 20.0 for merely not going extinct

bars.claim: Evolved genetics stay diverse; no mutation sweep, no gene pinned at an extreme.
bars.status: Clean at baseline. Across three seeds every gene sits in 0.56–1.45x and all eight mutations are present in single/low-double digits. The multiplicative-metabolism fix from HANDOFF §3.4 is holding.
bars.metric: no mutation above 18 individuals in a ~120-animal population

bars.claim: Wins or ties a blind A/B against The Bibites and Equilinox.
bars.status: Not close yet. Flat cropped grass texture, no resize handler so the canvas leaves a blank band, an energy bar and emoji stamped over all 758 entities reading as static, three HUD panels in three different design languages.
bars.metric: 1 reference screenshot captured, full audit in flight

bars.status: Simulation throughput measured; browser render path not yet measured. The render half is the suspect — per-entity strokeText for emoji, a 3000x2000 background PNG blitted every frame.

nextTarget.headline: Find out why the herbivores die.
nextTarget.body: Ten read-only diagnostic agents are running four lenses on the ecology (demography, energetics, behaviour, stability theory), three on the visuals, and three on engineering. No builder touches a file until they report. The leading hypothesis is that the forest is pinned flat at its carrying capacity (611 ± 21, CV 0.03) — a constant food supply rather than a prey population — which collapses the food web to plain Lotka-Volterra between herbivores and carnivores, and that always dies in a finite stochastic world.

rounds.title: Measure what is actually there
rounds.body: Before any change, run the real thing on seeds no previous tuning has seen and look at the pixels. The working tree had already drifted well past docs/HANDOFF.md: it now has soil nutrients and decomposition, a metapopulation rescue effect, a Holling type III refuge, Lindeman energy-transfer efficiency, food-gated reproduction and senescence. The docs describe an earlier world.

deadEnds: Trusting docs/HANDOFF.md §0 as current state. It describes a search that has since finished and a model that has since gained five new subsystems. Its methodology sections (§5, §6) are still exactly right; its status sections are not.

Reading 'all three species survived 60k frames' as passing the ALIVE bar. With the rescue effect on, survival is nearly guaranteed and says almost nothing. The honest test is survival with ecology.rescueChance forced to 0.
